items.title: Oracle Java SE 未授权远程漏洞
items.title_zh: Oracle Java SE 未授权远程漏洞
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者经多协议调用受影响API，可完全攻陷Java SE与GraalVM
items.affected: Oracle(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 应用Oracle CPU补丁；限制不可信网络访问受影响API
items.repro_note: 按Oracle CPU组件说明，通过网络协议调用受影响API验证
items.impact_scope: Java运行时，服务器/桌面广泛部署
items.description: Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Note: This vulnerability can be exploited by using APIs in the specified Component, e.g., through a web service which supplies data to the APIs.

items.title: ATS 源站认证签名越权
items.title_zh: ATS 源站认证签名越权
items.summary_zh: 客户端可强制代理以其AWS凭证签名攻击者指定的请求头，造成凭证滥用和越权请求
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 启用origin_server_auth后，构造指定AWS头触发签名
items.impact_scope: 缓存代理/边界节点，云凭证风险
items.description: Apache Traffic Server's origin_server_auth plugin lets a client force signing of attacker-chosen AWS request headers under the proxy's own credentials. This issue affects Apache Traffic Server: from 8.0.0 through 8.1.11, from 9.0.0 through 9.2.15, from 10.0.0 through 10.1.4, 10.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.16, 10.1.5, or 10.2.1, which fix the issue.

items.title: ATS TLS会话复用证书混淆
items.title_zh: ATS TLS会话复用证书混淆
items.summary_zh: 代理可能将某客户端证书认证的池化TLS会话复用于另一证书事务，导致证书校验绕过
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 默认出站会话共享下，用不同客户端证书复用池化TLS会话
items.impact_scope: 反向代理出站mTLS，凭证混淆
items.description: Apache Traffic Server's default outbound session-sharing policy can reuse a pooled TLS session authenticated with one client certificate for a transaction configured to present a different one. This issue affects Apache Traffic Server: from 9.0.0 through 9.2.15, from 10.0.0 through 10.1.4, 10.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.16, 10.1.5, or 10.2.1, which fix the issue.

items.title: ATS SNI跨虚拟主机证书绕过
items.title_zh: ATS SNI跨虚拟主机证书绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用跨SNI虚拟主机的TLS会话恢复，跳过严格客户端证书校验，冒充已认证客户端
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 先在一SNI主机完成客户端证书认证，再跨SNI恢复TLS会话
items.impact_scope: 反向代理/网关，mTLS认证绕过
items.description: Apache Traffic Server can resume a TLS session across SNI virtual hosts without re-verifying a client certificate required by the resumed host's verify_client STRICT policy. This issue affects Apache Traffic Server: from 8.0.0 through 8.1.11, from 9.0.0 through 9.2.15, from 10.0.0 through 10.1.4, 10.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.16, 10.1.5, or 10.2.1, which fix the issue.

items.title: TOTOLINK EX200 栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向cstecgi.cgi的Comment参数传超长数据触发栈溢出，可致崩溃或代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级最新固件；无法升级则关闭远程管理并限制管理口访问
items.impact_scope: 家用WiFi扩展器，管理口常暴露
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in TOTOLINK EX200 5.2.3c.7200. This affects the function setStaticDhcpConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component lan.so. The manipulation of the argument Comment results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: TOTOLINK EX200 MAC栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向cstecgi.cgi的macAddress参数传超长数据触发栈溢出，可致崩溃或代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级最新固件；无法升级则关闭远程管理并限制管理口访问
items.impact_scope: 家用WiFi扩展器，管理口常暴露
items.description: A weakness has been identified in TOTOLINK EX200 5.2.3c.7200. This impacts the function setWiFiAclAddConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component wireless.so. This manipulation of the argument macAddress causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: Tenda BE3L Pro 缓冲区溢出
items.title_zh: Tenda BE3L Pro 缓冲区溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向/goform/WifiBasicSet的security_5g参数传超长数据触发溢出，可致崩溃或代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级最新固件；无法升级则限制管理接口并关闭远程管理
items.impact_scope: 家用WiFi路由器，管理口暴露
items.description: A flaw has been found in Tenda BE3L Pro 16.03.60.62. Affected by this vulnerability is the function formWifiBasicSet of the file /goform/WifiBasicSet. This manipulation of the argument security_5g causes buffer overflow. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: Pillow 图像解析越界写
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用特制PSD/MPO/DCX/MIC图片触发帧转换越界写，可致崩溃或代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级至最新修复版本，限制不可信图片解析
items.repro_note: 解析特制PSD/MPO/DCX/MIC图像，触发帧转换越界
items.description: Pillow is a Python imaging library. Crafted PSD, MPO, DCX, or MIC frame transitions can then write wider pixels into the narrow allocation, causing native out-of-bounds writes and crashes.
